description: What historically happened to a crypto coin's price after a specific signal (e.g. RSI oversold, a 20% weekly drop, a breakout), measured on every past occurrence and compared with the coin's ordinary days. Returns case count, win rate, median move before and after trading costs, typical dip on the way, the luck probability after multiple-testing correction, and a 0-100 proof score. Statistics about past price behaviour on Binance daily candles. Not financial advice and not a prediction.

coin.description: Ticker or slug, e.g. BTC or bitcoin

signal.description: Signal id, e.g. rsi-oversold, weekly-drop-20, golden-cross
